scenario: The ego vehicle encounters a vehicle merging into its lane from a highway on-ramp and must react to avoid collision.

ego.behavior: The car travels straight along the highway lane and decelerates to accommodate the merging vehicle.

adversarials.behavior: The car merges from the highway on-ramp into the ego vehicle's lane ahead of the ego vehicle.

spatial_relation: On a multi-lane highway with an on-ramp, the ego vehicle is positioned in the main through lane while the adversarial vehicle starts on the on-ramp and merges into the ego lane.
requirements_and_restrictions: The ego vehicle must maintain safe following distance as the adversarial vehicle merges; the scenario terminates once the ego vehicle has successfully avoided collision and stabilized relative to the merged vehicle.
reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: Ego is the camera-host vehicle in the main highway lane; the adversarial is the merging vehicle on the on-ramp. 2. Enumeration: one adversarial Car. 3. Chronology: initially both vehicles approach the merge zone; midpoint the adversarial signals and begins merging into the ego lane; ending the ego decelerates to create space as the adversarial completes the merge. 4. Evidence: the adversarial's lateral position shifts from the on-ramp into the ego lane while the ego's speed visibly decreases to prevent contact.
